g.title: SANS
g.text: SANS — Simulated Annealing Neighbourhood Search (engines "new" and "og")

Single-vehicle profit-maximising SA over a set of routes plus a pool of removed bins. The "new" engine runs geometric-cooling SA with 18 route/add operators and re-heating; the legacy "og" (LAC) engine runs a fixed-iteration annealing over 19 random move/swap procedures followed by uncrossing, local-search refinement and rebalancing.

g.title: cluster_adapter
g.text: — SANSPolicy (registered as "sans"), execute() overrides the base flow

g.title: a_params
g.text: V (bin volume), shift_duration 8 h, combination 'best', seed

g.title: a_data
g.text: Load Q (capacity), R, C, B (density) for area / waste type
build DataFrame: #bin, Stock = bins.c, Accum_Rate = bins.means (+ depot row 0)

g.title: n_init
g.text: fill until capacity → routes; take route 0

g.title: g_vals
g.text: values = {Q, R, B, C, V, shift_duration, perc_bins_can_overflow}
[iterations 500, T_initial 75, T_param 0.95, p_vehicle, p_load 0.095, p_route_diff, p_shift]

g.title: n_mand
g.text: insert every mandatory bin missing from the route at position 1

g.title: n_state
g.text: current = routes with only known ids; missing bins → removed_bins pool

g.title: n_ops
g.text: valid ops = ROUTE ops (if any route):
2opt · move · swap · remove · insert · move_n_random · move_n_consec
+ ADD ops (if removed_bins non-empty): add_n_bins · add_n_bins_consec

g.title: n_cool
g.text: T ← α · T · recorder.record(T, best, current)

g.title: p_f
g.text: kg per bin = stock % · V · density / 100, counted only while cumulative load ≤ Q

g.title: n_ret
g.text: tour = best[0] · return tour, distance, profit

g.title: g_init
g.text: find_initial_solution(): zone-based construction with overflow prediction

g.title: g_ls
g.text: local_search(): pick one of 19 random procedures
Move/Swap 1 or 2 routes · Move/Swap n (random / consecutive) in 1 or 2 routes
Remove n bins (random / consecutive) · Add route (random / consecutive)
Add route with removed bins · Rearrange part of a route

g.title: g_rebal
g.text: rebalance_solution(): redistribute load / re-insert removed bins

g.title: g_ret
g.text: tour = routes[0] · cost = km · profit = Σ fill·R − cost·C
